The second raw text included the exact rule but malformed arg_key/arg_value tags around max_minutes_placeholder, so its parsed submission lacked required question_id. objective: Close the malformed-tool-body acceptance gap, then reduce one-shot Controller submission friction without silently repairing old model responses, choosing science for the Controller, or relaxing protected data and budget gates.
boundary: Offline diagnosis and tests only. No paid retry, no relabeling failed responses, no data fetch, admission, training, protected evaluation or purchase. Any future Controller call needs a newly reviewed source version, canary, fresh ID and exact budget check.

Confirm the published Tinker route cannot be assumed to enforce JSON Schema or grammar. Then compare a smaller trusted interface and stronger-controller option with explicit tradeoffs. A broad drop-extra-field projection is not a repair for the observed malformed tags.
